sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-2B Balanced 2B parameter model from the Qwen3.5 series for on‑device inference. Qwen3.5 is the latest multilingual language model series from Alibaba Cloud with improved reasoning and instruction‑following capabilities over Qwen3.

sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 features the following enhancement: Unified Vision-Language Foundation: Early fusion training on multimodal tokens achieves cross-generational parity with Qwen3 and outperforms Qwen3-VL models across reasoning, coding, agents, and visual understanding benchmarks.
